items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: But you know Paul Motian and Danilo Perez — early recording of Danilo — he wasn’t even 21 yet.

ctx.x: It might have helped. The music was fine. There was one called “Form.” It was also on Contemporary Records as a matter of fact. It was owned by Fantasy at that point. And I got to record a bunch of Tom’s records for them and then later the Chesky Brothers, Chesky Records with Tom. But you know Paul Motian and Danilo Perez — early recording of Danilo — he wasn’t even 21 yet.
